requirement: The `requirements` and `input` helper commands must return extracted text and input snapshots as JSON without writing evidence files.
justification: Scenarios: selected requirement metadata and exact input excerpt are requested in an isolated fixture without an evidence directory. The helper branches serialize their results and return before checking or writing; the test compares parsed JSON to expected values and asserts no evidence directory is created. Validated with cargo test --locked --offline --manifest-path language-lab-ci/Cargo.toml (20 tests passing). Each cited test uses isolated fixture files and asserts outcomes, not merely the presence of instructions. Revalidated helper success, JSON output and no evidence creation: both branches return before build_skill, and the helper subprocess tests pass without any embedded project. All 21 checker tests passed with cargo test --locked --offline --manifest-path language-lab-ci/Cargo.toml.
